name: content-smm
tagline_zh: 给 Destiny Matrix 和 Maria Lit 做社媒，不用每次重讲人设。输入主题和平台。
tagline_en: Stop re-explaining your brand for every post. Drop a topic, get platform-ready copy with hooks, CTAs, and emoji.
desc_en: Creates and rewrites Instagram captions, Reel scripts, Story sequences, carousel copy, content ideas, and weekly plans for SoulPlus AI (Destiny Matrix + AI) and Maria Lit. Use for SMM, social content, ToV rewrites, or /content.
why_zh: 它把「品牌人格」当成一个可复用变量，而不是每次在提示词里重写。同一套 ToV 自动适配四种内容形态。
why_en: Treats brand voice as a reusable variable, not a copy-paste chore. One ToV profile auto-shapes itself into four formats—tone.
limit_zh: 只认 SoulPlus AI（Destiny Matrix）和 Maria Lit 这两个品牌人格。
limit_en: Only ships with SoulPlus AI & Maria Lit voices built-in; other brands must supply a full ToV brief first. Output ends at copy & weekly plan—no.
title_en: One brand voice, auto-adapted for IG captions, Reels.
